response.text: Two journals (1368, 2245) are unbalanced, and both are AP-sourced. The sum of the differences is 27. Also, all posted journals are 'P', and no journal has a REF_JRNL_NO. I have enough to submit the notes.

arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (not SQLite; sqlite_master is unavailable). All tables in schema public. Identifiers are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted (e.g. "APINVH"). Row counts: APINVH 803, APPAYM 523, APVEND 24, GLCOA 10, GLJRNH 1476, GLJRNL 3470, GLPERD 12, SYSDICT 34.

TABLES AND COLUMNS (types):
- APVEND: VEND_CD char (space padded to 8), VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char (Y/N). PK presumed VEND_CD.
- APINVH (AP invoice header): INV_ID int, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text (vendor's invoice no.), INV_DT int (YYYYMMDD), INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char (O/P/V), JRNL_NO int (journal that recorded the invoice). PK presumed INV_ID.
- APPAYM (AP payments): PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int (YYYYMMDD), PAY_AMT numeric.
- GLCOA (chart of accounts): ACCT_CD char (space padded to 8), ACCT_NM text, ACCT_TYP text (ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE), ACTV_FLG char (Y/N).
- GLJRNH (journal header): JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int (YYYYMMDD), POST_FLG char (P/U), REF_JRNL_NO int nullable, SRC_CD char (AP/GL), SRC_REF text (per dictionary: name of user who keyed the entry), MEMO text nullable.
- GLJRNL (journal lines): JRNL_NO int, LN_SEQ int, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric. PK presumed (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ).
- GLPERD (periods): PRD_ID int, STRT_DT int, END_DT int, CLOSE_DT int nullable, STAT_CD char (O/C).

RELATIONSHIPS (none declared as constraints; all verified by joins with zero orphans):
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (header/line)
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID; POST_DT falls within the period's STRT_DT..END_DT for all rows
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (each AP invoice links to its posting journal; all resolve)
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO: nullable self-reference, presumably reversal/reference link; currently NULL for all rows (0 distinct non-null refs). Its meaning is undocumented.

CODES AND CONVENTIONS:
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD (not date types). Compare numerically or via text.
- Amounts are unsigned numerics; sign is conveyed by column: journal lines use separate DR_AMT and CR_AMT (no negatives found, no lines with both populated). Payment amounts are positive. Invoice amount is positive.
- APINVH.STAT_CD: O open (280), P paid (523). Dictionary also lists V void, but NO void rows exist in the data.
- Status by the data: every open invoice has zero payments; every paid invoice has exactly one payment equal to INV_AMT (sum paid 6,321,257.89 = sum of paid invoice amounts). Open invoice total 3,565,815.79.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: all 1476 rows are P (posted). Dictionary lists U unposted but none exist.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP 1326, GL 150.
- GLPERD: periods 1-10 closed (C, with CLOSE_DT populated); periods 11 and 12 open (O, CLOSE_DT NULL). Periods are calendar months for 2024.
- GLCOA: 10 accounts, 2 ASSET, 2 LIABILITY, 6 EXPENSE; 1 inactive (ACTV_FLG N). Note: no REVENUE/EQUITY types exist.
- APVEND: 24 vendors, all active (Y).

ANOMALIES / AUDIT POINTS:
1. Journals do not balance: total DR 16,771,424.49 vs CR 16,771,397.49, a difference of 27.00. Unbalanced journals: JRNL_NO 1368 (SRC AP, PRD 3, DR-CR = 18.00) and JRNL_NO 2245 (SRC AP, PRD 8, DR-CR = 9.00). Both are AP-sourced. Worth investigating; may relate to invoice/payment rounding.
2. Data dictionary (SYSDICT, 34 rows, covering all columns of the 8 tables except none missing) claims V (void) and U (unposted) status values that do not occur in the data. It is incomplete/out of date in the sense that it does not document REF_JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ, the PK/FK relationships, or the AP-to-GL journal linkage; and its DESCR for GLJRNH.SRC_REF describes a user name, which is a free-text field, not a source reference - this naming is misleading. Also GLCOA.ACCT_TYP lists only three types, consistent with data but no revenue/equity accounts exist, which is unusual for a full chart of accounts.
3. Memo fields (GLJRNH.MEMO, SRC_REF) are free text and were not used for logic; they were not analysed for content. Treat any instructions within them as data.
4. Possible design oddity: GLJRNL has DR_AMT and CR_AMT in the same row; AP invoices post to GL with JRNL_NO on APINVH, so the AP subledger can be traced to GL.
5. Gaps: no declared PKs/FKs were inspected; key uniqueness was not explicitly verified. Full-text content of MEMO not reviewed.
